- Lasagna slice: about 250 g at roughly 150 kcal/100 g, so about 375 kcal.
- Coleslaw: about 100 g at roughly 120 kcal/100 g, so about 120 kcal.
- Anzac biscuit: about 40 g, so about 180 kcal.

Eaten: about 575 g and about 745 kcal.
